### LocalAI

- **LocalAI** · self — LocalAI uses a small core plus separate backend images (llama.cpp, vLLM, SGLang, MLX, whisper.cpp, diffusers, and others), each pulled on demand only when a model needs it. (high confidence) — https://github.com/mudler/LocalAI
